sql_blueprint.template:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Inter-State (IGST)'
    WHEN tax_cgst_rate > 0 THEN 'Intra-State (CGST+SGST)'
    WHEN tax_ugst_rate > 0 THEN 'Union Territory (UGST)'
    ELSE 'Unknown / Zero-rated'
  END AS gst_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
  SUM(total_tax) AS total_tax_collected,
  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_base,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_tax) / NULLIF(SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax), 0), 2) AS effective_tax_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type = 'forward'
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_tax_collected DESC

sql_blueprint.template:
SELECT
  sku_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) AS forward_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END) AS return_orders,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date >= :start_date */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date < :end_date */
GROUP BY sku_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) > 0
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, return_orders DESC

SELECT

    WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Inter-State (IGST)'
    WHEN tax_cgst_rate > 0 THEN 'Intra-State (CGST+SGST)'
    WHEN tax_ugst_rate > 0 THEN 'Union Territory (UGST)'

  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
  SUM(total_tax) AS total_tax_collected,

    sku_id

       AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee', 'tech fee', 'pickup fee')
      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0

       AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee', 'tech fee', 'pickup fee')
      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0

    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'commission'
      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0

    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'refund commission'
      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0

  SUM(GREATEST(fc.operational_fees_charged - fc.operational_fees_recovered, 0)) AS unrecovered_operational_fees,
  SUM(GREATEST(fc.commission_charged - fc.commission_recovered, 0)) AS unrecovered_commission,

    + GREATEST(fc.operational_fees_charged - fc.operational_fees_recovered, 0)
    + GREATEST(fc.commission_charged - fc.commission_recovered, 0)
  ) AS estimated_return_loss
FROM return_orders ro
LEFT JOIN fee_components fc
  ON ro.order_id = fc.order_id

SELECT
  sku_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) AS forward_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END) AS return_orders,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date >= :start_date */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date < :end_date */
GROUP BY sku_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) > 0
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, return_orders DESC

sql_blueprint.template:
SELECT
  sku_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) AS forward_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END) AS return_orders,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date >= :start_date */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date < :end_date */
GROUP BY sku_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) > 0
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, return_orders DESC

fields.time_basis: created_date or settlement_date depending on source table

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Inter-State (IGST)'
    WHEN tax_cgst_rate > 0 THEN 'Intra-State (CGST+SGST)'
    WHEN tax_ugst_rate > 0 THEN 'Union Territory (UGST)'
    ELSE 'Unknown / Zero-rated'
  END AS gst_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
  SUM(total_tax) AS total_tax_collected,
  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_base,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_tax) / NULLIF(SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax), 0), 2) AS effective_tax_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type = 'forward'
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_tax_collected DESC

SELECT
  sku_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) AS forward_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END) AS return_orders,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date >= :start_date */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date < :end_date */
GROUP BY sku_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) > 0
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, return_orders DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Inter-State (IGST)'
    WHEN tax_cgst_rate > 0 THEN 'Intra-State (CGST+SGST)'
    WHEN tax_ugst_rate > 0 THEN 'Union Territory (UGST)'
    ELSE 'Unknown / Zero-rated'
  END AS gst_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
  SUM(total_tax) AS total_tax_collected,
  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_base,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_tax) / NULLIF(SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax), 0), 2) AS effective_tax_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
WHERE is_active = true
  AND transaction_type = 'forward'
  /* optional runtime scope: AND group_level_id = :group_level_id */
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_tax_collected DESC

sql_blueprint.template:
WITH return_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    order_id,
    sku_id
  FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms o
  WHERE o.is_active = true
    AND o.transaction_type = 'reverse'
    /* optional runtime scope: AND o.group_level_id = :group_level_id */
),
fee_components AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund'
       AND mp_fee_type = 'ItemPrice'
       AND charged_amount_type = 'principal'
      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0
    END) AS refunded_principal,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Order'
       AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee', 'tech fee', 'pickup fee')
      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0
    END) AS operational_fees_charged,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund'
       AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee', 'tech fee', 'pickup fee')
      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0
    END) AS operational_fees_recovered,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'commission'
      THEN ABS(charged_amount) ELSE 0
    END) AS commission_charged,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'refund commission'
      THEN charged_amount ELSE 0
    END) AS commission_recovered
  FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment d
  WHERE d.is_active = true
    /* optional runtime scope: AND d.group_level_id = :group_level_id */
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  ro.sku_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ro.order_id) AS return_orders,
  SUM(fc.refunded_principal) AS refunded_principal,
  SUM(GREATEST(fc.operational_fees_charged - fc.operational_fees_recovered, 0)) AS unrecovered_operational_fees,
  SUM(GREATEST(fc.commission_charged - fc.commission_recovered, 0)) AS unrecovered_commission,
  SUM(
    fc.refunded_principal
    + GREATEST(fc.operational_fees_charged - fc.operational_fees_recovered, 0)
    + GREATEST(fc.commission_charged - fc.commission_recovered, 0)
  ) AS estimated_return_loss
FROM return_orders ro
LEFT JOIN fee_components fc
  ON ro.order_id = fc.order_id
GROUP BY ro.sku_id
ORDER BY estimated_return_loss DESC

fields.time_basis: created_date or settlement_date depending on source table

SELECT
  sku_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) AS forward_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END) AS return_orders,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN order_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms

  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date >= :start_date */
  /* optional runtime window: AND created_date < :end_date */
GROUP BY sku_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END) > 0
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, return_orders DESC
